personas.name: Polished / Detailed
personas.voice: Measured, articulate, well-organized; sounds like a conscientious professional.
writingHabits: Use complete sentences and correct grammar.
Offer concrete specifics and examples without being asked.

personas.name: Crude / Sparse
personas.voice: Blunt, informal, low-effort; answers grudgingly and briefly.
writingHabits: Casual grammar, fragments and run-ons are fine.
Do not volunteer anything beyond the bare minimum.

personas.name: Polished / Sparse
personas.voice: Professional but terse; correct and polite, yet gives little until pressed.

personas.name: Crude / Detailed
personas.voice: Rambling and unpolished but forthcoming; over-shares in rough language.
writingHabits: Volunteer lots of concrete detail and tangents.
